 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Cameron Norrie was knocked out of the Stockholm Open following a straight-sets defeat to Taylor Fritz in the round of 16.
 World number 10 Fritz battled to clinch the first set 7-5 and subsequently wrapped up the win with a 6-3 victory in the second set to book his spot in the quarter-finals.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Norrie reached Tuesday's last-16 clash with a straight-sets win over James Duckworth in the opening round, while number-one seed Fritz received a bye into the second round.
 Fritz started the match strongly with two aces to hold in the opening game, but had his serve broken by Norrie in the third game.

 The Briton strengthened his grip as he held his serve, but Fritz replied with a break of his own to take the contest to 5-5.
 He piled on the pressure, serving three aces in the following game and broke Norrie's serve in the 12th game to win the first set.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A tight tussle saw little separate the pair in the second set until Norrie had his serve broken in the eighth game and Fritz subsequently held serve to see out the match.
